verdict.rationale: Ramp supports multi-item work mainly through scripting rather than native bulk actions. The CLI's `--agent` JSON mode is documented as "built for scripted loops," and agents can "pull full spend exports" and run SQL-style analysis across transactions. The CLI and API also expose per-item approve and edit actions that an agent could loop over. Missing for 10: any documented native bulk or batch endpoint or command (e.g., bulk-approve, mass-recode, batch card issuance), evidence of bulk write semantics such as partial-failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
